refundSummary: Request a refund within 72 hours of the first successful subscription payment. All requests require human review. Eligible amounts include the initial payment and paid upgrades on the same subscription, excluding PAYG top-ups and overage. Upgrades, migration and repeat requests do not restart the window. After approval, the system executes the refund; funds typically return to the original payment method within 3–5 business days after a successful refund.
planChangeSummary: Upgrades and downgrades share one change per user in a rolling 30-day window. First purchases, automatic renewals and expiry do not count; replacing a subscription does not reset the limit. Paid upgrades preserve usage and replace, rather than stack, allowances. Downgrades take effect at the end of the paid term without an automatic refund. Monthly-to-annual upgrades are not yet available.
cancellationSummary: Cancel renewal without administrator approval or upgrade cooldown restrictions. Repeated cancellation of the same subscription returns the original result. Paid access continues until term end, then changes to Free. Self-service cancellation reversal is not available yet.
refundReviewSummary: While review is pending, existing paid access and cancellation remain available; new upgrades and downgrades are paused. Investigation is distinct from rejection. Approval binds the original payments, currencies and per-payment limits. Partial completion is not reported as a completed refund. Access changes to Free only after all approved refunds succeed and the subscription is terminated.
refundExceptionSummary: Unclear payment ownership, inseparable mixed invoices, currency or amount anomalies, unmanaged schedules and persistent reconciliation discrepancies require audited administrator handling. High usage, multiple accounts or a shared IP may prompt review but are not standalone reasons for automatic rejection.
